Under its default (`true`) they are dropped even when named here, so `type=DEPOSIT` or `type=WITHDRAWAL` alone returns an empty page. `DIRECTIONAL_SPLIT`, `DIRECTIONAL_MERGE`, `THRESHOLD_COMPOSE` and `THRESHOLD_DECOMPOSE` are operations on range events, whose outcomes are value buckets and whose lines are ABOVE / BELOW positions over those buckets. A directional split turns collateral plus the buckets between two lines into ABOVE the lower line and BELOW the higher one; a directional merge reverses it. Both are rows of the whole event, so a `condition` filter never returns them. A threshold compose turns buckets into one line position and a threshold decompose turns it back; these rows carry the line's market and side. Split, merge, redeem and conversion on a range event keep `SPLIT`, `MERGE`, `REDEEM` and `CONVERSION`. `TIP` is **opt-in**: it is never in the default set, so it is only returned when you name it here. A tip is a user↔user pUSD transfer that is not a trade-settlement leg; `size` is the amount and `side` carries the direction (`IN` received / `OUT` sent).

reproposed_price.description: Price of the second proposal, same conventions as `proposed_price`.

resolution_source.description: `reported` (an oracle reported it) or `derived` (a neg-risk sibling resolution no client can reconstruct).

resolved_at.description: When the condition resolved, RFC3339 UTC.

settlement_time_basis.description: How `expected_settlement_time` was derived: `managed_proposal_expiration` or `proposal_expiration` (end of a live proposal's challenge window), `liveness` (end of a proposal window on the v2 oracle) or `dvm_round_estimate` (earliest end of the voting round a disputed market can settle in); omitted when no estimate applies.

status.description: Lifecycle state: initialized, posed, proposed, challenged, reproposed, disputed or resolved; condition-keyed rows can also serve active and arbitration.

transaction_hash.description: Transaction of the latest lifecycle event; empty on condition-keyed rows without one.

was_arbitrated.description: Whether arbitration was triggered on the request.

was_disputed.description: Whether the resolution was disputed at any point.

data.Envelope_Vec_TokenRef.description: `{ "data": T }`; the envelope for endpoints that don't paginate. There is no `pagination` key: an aggregate or bounded list has no next page. Paginated feeds return a `*Page` shape (`{ data, pagination }`) instead.

items.description: One `/v2/tokens` row: the reference facts for one ERC-1155 token id.

clob_index.description: Position of the token in the market's CLOB token list; null until the settlement writer has placed the token, and always null outside `v1_ctf`.

closed.description: Whether the market is closed; null when the market is not mirrored.

condition_id.description: The market's condition id in its 66-character form, the value the other routes carry on their rows.

event_id.description: Lowest event id the market belongs to; null when none is mirrored.

event_slug.description: Slug of that event; null when none is mirrored.

final_price.description: Payout rate of the token once resolved (0 lost, 1 won, fractions for split payouts); null while unresolved.

market_slug.description: Market slug; null when the market is not mirrored.

module.description: The contract family that issued the token: `v1_ctf` is the ConditionalTokens market (module 0), every other value is a polymarket-v2 module.

neg_risk.description: Whether the market belongs to a neg-risk structure; null when the market is not mirrored.

neg_risk_market_id.description: The neg-risk structure's market id; null outside neg-risk markets.

opposite_token_id.description: The other token of a two-outcome condition; null otherwise.

outcome.description: Outcome label from the market's outcome list; null when no label slot applies or the market is not mirrored.

outcome_index.description: On-chain outcome slot of the token within its condition.

question_index.description: Index of the market inside its neg-risk structure: for `v1_ctf` the last byte of the question id, for `neg_risk` the last byte of the polymarket-v2 condition id; null outside neg-risk markets.

resolved.description: True once the token has an on-chain payout.

structural_condition_id.description: The on-chain polymarket-v2 condition id of the token in its 66-character form (the id a combo leg carries as `leg_condition_id`, plus the `00` byte); null for `v1_ctf`, whose only id is `condition_id`. On a native polymarket-v2 market it equals `condition_id`; on a market carried over to polymarket-v2 it is a different value. Accepted as a `condition` selector.

title.description: Market question; null when the market is not mirrored.

token_id.description: Decimal ERC-1155 token id, as a string.

data.Holder.description: One `/v2/holders` row: a market holder enriched with their public profile, netted across the market's outcome tokens by default or at per-side gross grain with the position economics when `include_pnl=true`. `profile_image_optimized` is always empty.

amount.description: Holding in shares. By default the NET figure (a fully hedged wallet nets to `0.0` and only appears at `min_balance=0`); with `include_pnl=true` the per-side GROSS figure, so each side of a hedged wallet appears under its own token with that side's full size.

avg_price.description: Historical entry price per share. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

current_price.description: Current price of the held outcome token, bounded to `[0, 1]`. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

current_value.description: Mark value of the holding: `amount` times `current_price`. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

display_username_public.description: Whether the profile chose to show its name publicly.

entry_cost_usdc.description: Cost basis of the held size in USDC, excluding entry fees. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

name.description: Profile display name of the wallet.

outcome_index.description: Index of the held outcome within the market; `999` means unlabelable.

profile_image_optimized.description: Resized profile image URL, when one exists.

pseudonym.description: Generated fallback handle for profiles without a display name.

realized_pnl.description: Profit already locked in by sells and redemptions. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

total_pnl.description: Total profit and loss; always `realized_pnl + unrealized_pnl`. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

unrealized_pnl.description: Mark-to-market profit on the held size: `current_value` minus `entry_cost_usdc`. Served only with `include_pnl=true`.

data.HoldersPage.description: `{ data, pagination }` envelope for `/v2/holders`; an offset-cursor feed (per outcome token): the offset lives behind the opaque token, never on the wire.

data.IngestionFreshness.description: Ingestion health: one cursor per `(contract, event)` stream. Every figure here is over the LIVE streams only. Streams that are dormant by design sit arbitrarily far behind forever; they are dropped outright rather than reported and flagged, because there is nothing a consumer could do with them and including them is precisely what makes the list useless.

chain_id.description: The chain id this service is configured for. Echoed so the pairing above is readable in one response.

cursors.description: How many live streams were found. `0` means no ingestion cursors are visible to this API at all.

max_synced_block.description: The tail: the furthest-along cursor. Every `behind_max` is measured against it, and so is each serving mechanism's `blocks_behind`.

min_synced_block.description: The furthest-behind LIVE stream's block. Deliberately asymmetric with `max_synced_block` above, which is over ALL cursors: the tail must not move with the dormant cut, or excluding a stream would redefine the distance every other stream is measured against.

oneOf.description: The single furthest-behind live stream. A stall confined to one stream while every sibling sits at head is invisible in any aggregate figure.

network.description: The chain the ingestion cursors were written for, as the datastore itself names it; NOT as this service is configured. Compared against `chain_id`, it catches a datastore pointed at the wrong chain, which otherwise presents as data that is merely wrong. `null` when no stream declares one.

data.LeaderboardEntry.description: One `/v2/leaderboard` row: a user's standing on the ranked board. `pnl` is realized USDC over the window, base and combo positions unified. `volume` is both-sides SHARES, not USDC. `rank` is a competition rank; tied users share one, and the next rank skips.

pnl.description: Window PnL in USDC. Finite windows (day/week/month) are the MARKED equity change net of flows; realized plus mark moves; `all` is the realized-only lifetime ledger. The two deliberately differ.

rank.description: Rank on the requested board; ties share a rank and the next skips.

user_name.description: Profile display name of the wallet.

volume.description: Both-sides traded volume in shares; never USD.

x_username.description: Linked X handle, when one exists.

data.LeaderboardPage.description: `{ data, pagination }` envelope for `/v2/leaderboard`; an offset-cursor board. `rank` ties and skips, so the offset behind the token is the only sound way to page; never derive a page from a rank.

data.LeaderboardResponse.description: Either arm's body. `?user=` answers with one standing; everything else with a page of the board; genuinely different shapes, so the spec says `oneOf` rather than pretending one covers both.

data.MetaHolder.description: One outcome token's holder group in `/v2/holders`: the `token_id` and its holders, top-N by net balance. A multi-market request interleaves tokens across the page, so merge groups by `token_id`, not by array position.

holders.description: Top holders of that token, amount descending (net by default, per-side gross with `include_pnl=true`).

token_id.description: The outcome token this group ranks.

has_more.description: Exact: `true` iff another page exists; probe-based, never inferred from page fullness.

limit.description: Page size this page was served with.

next_cursor.description: Opaque, signed cursor for the next page; `null` on the last page.

offset.description: Running item offset for display continuity across keyset pages (the cursor drives the actual seek; this is cosmetic; there is no total).

data.Position.description: One position (`/v2/positions`); a holding in a single outcome token, priced and enriched. The shape is **uniform across all three arms** (user OPEN/REDEEMABLE, user CLOSED, market-anchored): clients never branch on which spine answered. On the CLOSED arm `current_size`/`current_value`/`unrealized_pnl` are ~0 by construction, which is exactly what a closed position should report. Keyset-paginated on the active `sort_by` key: follow the response's `next_cursor` to page, and expect the ordering to change with `sort_by`.

archived.description: Whether the market is archived; tells a caller using `includeArchived` which rows the flag surfaced.

avg_price.description: Weighted-average entry price per share, in USDC.

condition_id.description: The on-chain condition id.

current_price.description: Live mark per share, in USDC.

current_size.description: The CURRENT holding, in shares (~0 residual on the CLOSED arm).

end_date.description: Market end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; `1970-01-01` when Gamma has none.

entry_fees_usdc.description: Attributed BUY-fee total for the position. Disclosure only: `entry_cost_usdc` is already fee-exclusive, so never re-deduct this from a PnL column.

event_id.description: Gamma event id of the parent event.

event_title.description: Parent event title; `""` when Gamma has none.

first_entry_at.description: First acquisition of the position (buy, split, mint, transfer in), epoch seconds; 0 when no acquisition is recorded.

group_item_title.description: Gamma's short label for this market inside a multi-market event (e.g. `Rene Haas` under `Next CEO of NVIDIA?`); `""` for single-market events.

last_event_at.description: The row's last economics event, epoch seconds; 0 without native state.

mergeable.description: Whether the wallet also holds the opposite outcome, so the pair can merge back into collateral.

name.description: Profile display name of the wallet.

negative_risk.description: Whether the market belongs to a neg-risk group.

opposite_outcome.description: Label of the market's other outcome; what a merge pairs with.

opposite_token_id.description: Token id of the market's other outcome.

outcome_index.description: Index of the held outcome within the market; `999` means the outcome could not be labeled.

percent_pnl.description: `(current_value - entry_cost_usdc) / entry_cost_usdc`, as a percent. Fee-exclusive basis, and the numerator is `unrealized_pnl`; not `total_pnl / total_cost_usdc`.

percent_realized_pnl.description: `(current_value - total_size × avg_price) / (total_size × avg_price)`, as a percent. A compatibility shape: despite the name, it is not `realized_pnl` over a basis.

realized_pnl.description: Realized PnL in USDC, cumulative for the position.

redeemable.description: Whether the position can be redeemed now: its market resolved and the tokens are still held (losing sides included; redeemable ≠ won).

slug.description: Market slug; the URL segment on polymarket.com.

status.description: The row's actual state; can be narrower than the requested `status`, since an `OPEN` request also returns `REDEEMABLE` rows.

title.description: Market question title (Gamma enrichment; empty when unenriched).

total_cost_usdc.description: Gross (fee-INCLUSIVE) basis. Always exactly `entry_cost_usdc + entry_fees_usdc`; the contract sums the two served columns, so the identity holds on every row of every arm.

total_size.description: LIFETIME bought shares (the WAC denominator), never the current balance; that is `current_size`.

data.PositionsSnapshotPage.description: `{ data, summary, pagination }`: `summary` is present on the first page only.

data.description: The page's positions, in the walk's stable order (not `asset` order).

pagination.description: Page size, display offset, `has_more` and the `next_cursor` to follow.

oneOf.description: The day's totals; present on the first page only.

price.description: Price in the range 0…1. Always a JSON number.

resolution_seconds.description: Width of the window this price was observed in: `0` for an exact tick, the bucket width for an aggregate. So the price was observed within `[timestamp, timestamp + resolution_seconds)`, and a caller can tell whether that is precise enough. Per-point rather than per-response because points in one response genuinely differ: grid points carry the requested bucket width, the series' terminal point is an exact tick at `0`, and a tier-degraded `as_of` carries its tier's width. This is the ONLY thing the payload says about provenance, deliberately.

timestamp.description: The OBSERVATION's own time, epoch seconds, never the time that was asked for. A raw tick reports the tick; an aggregate reports its bucket start.

data.PricesHistoryPage.description: `{ data, pagination }` envelope for `/v2/prices-history`. The terminal point (the latest observation inside the window) is part of the series and lands on the final page, so a client that wants the freshest value on a multi-page series follows the cursor to the end.

data.ServingFreshness.description: What API consumers actually experience: the projections behind the feeds. One headline number and the name of whichever mechanism produced it, so a single stalled projection cannot hide behind two healthy ones; the same shape as `ingestion.most_lagged`, for the same reason.

lag_seconds.description: The worst age across `mechanisms`. `null` only when no mechanism reported at all.

mechanisms.description: Every mechanism that produced a candidate freshness row, in a fixed order; `worst` names the culprit.

age_seconds.description: Seconds since it last advanced, by its own clock.

blocks_behind.description: How far behind the ingestion tail it has projected. Absent for a mechanism that records a time but no block.

data.SnapshotPosition.description: One position held at the end of the day, valued at the cut.

avg_price.description: `cost_basis / size`, entry fees included (`/v2/positions` reports its `avg_price` without fees).

condition_id.description: The market's condition id (66 characters), or the combo condition id of a combo position; null when the token is unknown.

cost_basis.description: The remaining cost basis of the shares in USDC, entry fees included (the `total_cost_usdc` of the same position on `/v2/positions`).

event_slug.description: The slug of the market's Gamma event; null for combos.

module.description: The contract family: 0 ConditionalTokens, 1 and 2 polymarket-v2 binary and neg-risk, 3 combo, 4 directional.

outcome.description: The outcome label; `Yes` or `No` for a combo.

price.description: The price at the cut: the payout for `settlement`, the mark (0 to 1) for `mark`, and `avg_price` for `basis`, which can exceed 1.

price_source.description: Where `price` came from: `settlement` (the market resolved before the cut: its payout), `mark` (the last market price recorded at a midnight on or before the day), or `basis` (no price: the average price, so `value` equals `cost_basis`).

size.description: Shares held at the end of the day.

slug.description: The current Gamma market slug; null for combos.

title.description: The current Gamma market question; null for combos.

data.SnapshotSummary.description: The totals of every position of the day; on the first page only.

closed_block.description: The highest block of the day's recorded moves.

cost_basis.description: The remaining cost basis of every position, in USDC.

positions.description: Positions held at the end of the day (every page together).

value.description: The value of every position at the cut, in USDC.

basis.description: Value of the positions with no price (their cost basis).

mark.description: Value of the positions priced at a recorded midnight market price.

settlement.description: Value of the positions whose market resolved before the cut.

data.TokenModule.description: The contract family that issued a token. `v1_ctf` is the ConditionalTokens market (module 0); every other value is a polymarket-v2 module.

condition_id.description: On-chain condition id of the market (`0x` hex).

name.description: Profile display name of the wallet.

outcome_index.description: Index of the traded outcome within the market; `999` means the outcome could not be labeled.

price.description: Execution price per share, in USDC.

proxy_wallet.description: Proxy wallet the row belongs to; the address every wallet-keyed endpoint accepts as `user`.

pseudonym.description: Generated fallback handle for profiles without a display name.

size.description: Filled quantity in shares; bare sizes are shares, never USD.

fees_paid.description: Refunds minus charges; a disclosure, not another PnL adjustment.

realized_lp_pnl.description: Realized PnL from AMM liquidity-provision activity.

source_block.description: Chain block the point was observed at.

volume_usdc.description: Cumulative maker-attributed canonical exchange fill cash in USDC.

wallet_income.description: All income credited to the wallet: rebates (maker + taker) plus reward, yield and referral income.

withdrawals.description: Collateral moved out of the wallet.

tr.description: Optional trigger attached to this order.

valid.description: Whether the invite code can be used.

trade_id.description: Decimal UInt64 trade ID from the public fills API.

timestamp.description: Public fill timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

history_as_of_at.description: Event time of the serving gateway's captured state and completed-history prefix, in Unix milliseconds. Missing trades are not_found at this horizon; horizons can differ by gateway.

registered.description: Whether the address has a Perps account.

perps.children_volume.description: Total notional volume traded by directly referred child accounts since their referral was applied

perps.close_only.description: Whether user orders must be reduce-only. Pricing, funding, and risk management continue until settlement.

perps.competition_include_unqualified.description: List the traders still short of the entry gate after the ranked board. Ignored for a lottery or raffle board.

perps.error.description: Error identifier. For domain rejections and transport errors (`401`/`404`/`429`/`500`) this is a stable, machine-readable snake_case identifier that is part of the API contract and safe to branch on, e.g. `insufficient_margin`, `insufficient_balance`, `order_not_found`, `reduce_only_invalid`, `price_outside_bounds`, `position_not_found`, `position_exists`, `open_orders_exist`, `invalid_margin_mode`, `invalid_margin_amount`, `margin_below_required_initial`, `account_liquidating`, `instrument_close_only`, `instrument_settled`, `settlement_price_unavailable`, `settlement_insurance_insufficient`, `settlement_invalid_state`, `unauthorized`, `not_found`. `instrument_close_only` means user orders must reduce an existing position; `instrument_settled` is permanent. Settlement readiness errors leave the instrument and accounts unchanged. For `400` it is a human-readable validation detail whose wording may change. See the Error handling guide for the domain identifiers. (Post-only / Fill-or-Kill outcomes are order statuses such as `post_only_rejected`, not rejections.)

perps.exchange_fees.description: Gross positive maker and taker trading fees in USD for the requested window, as an unformatted numeric string. Rebates, incentives, referral payments, and additional builder fees are excluded.

perps.exchange_volume.description: Matched trading volume in USD notional for the requested window, as an unformatted numeric string

perps.exp.description: Command-processing deadline in Unix milliseconds, not an order auto-cancel time; the server caps it at now + 5 s, clamps larger values to that cap, and uses that 5 s default when omitted. Values at or before the server's clock are rejected with HTTP 400 (command expired).

perps.fee.description: Signed exchange fee for this trade side, excluding builder_fee. Negative values are rebates

Builder fees are additional and are not part of this tier. Defaults to 0 without a current tier assignment and is capped at the highest configured tier. WebSocket tier changes appear on the next portfolio update, published every 5 seconds.

perps.fid.description: Funding payment ID. Probabilistically unique (same guarantees as trade IDs) and stable across REST and WebSocket for the same funding record.

perps.fills_cursor.description: Opaque keyset pagination cursor for the next page of fills. Present while `more` is true; pass it as `cursor` on the next request, keeping the other parameters the same across pages.

perps.hash.description: On-chain transaction hash, "0x" if not yet mined

perps.history_sequence.description: Engine sequence of the history event.

perps.in_liquidation.description: Whether the account is currently under liquidation

perps.initial_margin.description: Current collateral backing the position. For cross positions, this is the required initial margin based on position size, mark price, the applicable risk tier, and configured leverage. For isolated positions, this is the position's current equity: signed allocated margin plus unrealized PnL minus settled funding. The legacy `initial_margin` name is retained for API compatibility; `margin` would more accurately describe the field.

perps.isolated_only.description: Whether the instrument supports only isolated account margin. When false, both cross and isolated account margin modes are supported.

perps.kline.description: - `1767225600000` - Open time - `"100.00"` - Open price - `"105.00"` - High price - `"99.00"` - Low price - `"102.00"` - Close price - `"500.00"` - Volume (base unit) - `42` - Number of trades

perps.label.description: Human-readable label for a proxy key or internal transfer

perps.lid.description: Liquidation ID. Identifies one absorption of an account's positions by the insurance fund. Probabilistically unique (same guarantees as trade IDs).

perps.limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

perps.liq.description: Whether this fill was part of a liquidation of the account's position — true on forced closes and on any fill executed while the account was under liquidation on the instrument, maker or taker. False on the counterparty leg of an auto-deleveraging or backstop match — its fill is part of someone else's liquidation, flagged by `adl` where applicable

perps.maker_fee_rate.description: Exchange maker fee rate as a decimal fraction, excluding any per-order builder fee

perps.maker_share_7d.description: Rolling 7-day account maker volume divided by total exchange volume

perps.maker_volume_7d.description: Rolling 7-day perpetual maker volume in USD

perps.margin_amount.description: Signed isolated-margin adjustment in the instrument quote asset. Positive values add allocation; negative values remove it.

perps.mark_point.description: - `1767225600000` - Bucket open time (ms) - `"160.00"` - Last mark price in bucket

perps.market.description: Whether the trigger executes as a market order

perps.max_limit_notional.description: Maximum limit order notional value in USD

perps.max_market_notional.description: Maximum market order notional value in USD

perps.mgn.description: Net margin transferred to the insurance fund in USD, covering the quote asset only. Negative when the fund returned more isolated margin than the account's balance covered, i.e. it absorbed bad debt.

perps.min_volume.description: Minimum volume threshold for this tier

perps.min_volume_30d.description: Minimum rolling 30-day notional volume in USD required for this tier

perps.name.description: Exchange name used in the EIP-712 domain.

perps.notif_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the next_cursor value from the previous page to fetch the next, older page. Null when there are no more pages.

perps.notif_id.description: Stable notification id. The same notification always has the same id on the WebSocket feed and in the notifications history, so you can safely deduplicate across the two.

perps.notional.description: Trading volume in USD notional as an unformatted numeric string

perps.op_amount.description: Raw token amount in base units, matching the uint256 amount in the EIP-712 signature (e.g. "100000000" for 100 USDC with 6 decimals).

perps.open_interest.description: One-sided open interest in number of contracts (total long size, equal to total short size); multiply by mark price for quote-asset notional

perps.open_interest_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the open-interest sample in Unix milliseconds. Null when no complete sample is available.

perps.open_orders_limit.description: Maximum number of open orders per account

perps.open_price.description: Opening price of the earliest populated candle in the rolling 24-hour window, whose start is rounded down to the minute. Returns "0" when the window has no candles.

perps.parent_oid.description: Parent entry order id. Optional — omit it (do not send `0`) when the parent is created in the same request (inline `CreateOrder.tpsl` or `CreateTpSlArgs.parent`); the gateway auto-wires the child to it. perps.pep.description: Position entry price before the fill

perps.price_decimals.description: Number of decimal places for price. Non-integer prices have a maximum of 5 significant figures; integer prices are allowed regardless of significant figures.

perps.quantity_decimals.description: Number of decimal places for quantity.

perps.rank.description: Leaderboard rank under the requested ranking metric, starting at 1

perps.rate_burst_limit.description: Legacy limit-tier request-rate field. It is not used for gateway enforcement.

perps.rate_per_minute_limit.description: Maximum IP request weight per minute. In limit tiers, this is a legacy field and is not used for gateway enforcement.

perps.rate_reset.description: Timestamp in milliseconds when the current interval resets

perps.read_at.description: When the recipient marked this notification read, Unix milliseconds; null if unread.

perps.referrals_left.description: Number of additional referrals remaining for this account's invite code

perps.return_on_equity.description: Unrealized PnL divided by the position's current required initial margin, as a decimal.

perps.reward_amount.description: Reward amount attributed to this reward row

perps.reward_distributed.description: Whether rewards for this period have been marked as distributed

perps.reward_pool.description: Configured reward pool for the instrument

perps.roi.description: Return on investment over the window as a fraction, not a percentage ("0.4527" is 45.27%): `pnl / max(100, starting_equity + max_net_deposits)`. `pnl` is this row's `pnl`. `starting_equity` is the account equity sampled last before the window start (0 for `all`, and 0 for accounts with no earlier sample). `max_net_deposits` is the running maximum, over the window, of cumulative credited deposits minus withdrawals plus transfers in minus transfers out, starting from 0 at the window start; it is never negative. The 100 USD floor keeps tiny accounts from producing extreme ratios. Rounded half-even to 6 decimal places with trailing zeros removed; "0" when `pnl` is 0.

perps.settlement_fill.description: Whether this fill closes a position during permanent instrument settlement. Settlement fills use the final settlement price and have no fees or liquidation penalties; they are not normal market trades or ADL.

perps.settlement_insurance_debit.description: Total quote asset amount debited from the insurance fund to cover eligible settlement deficits.

perps.settlement_price.description: Final settlement price from the trailing 30-minute time-weighted index average. Every remaining position closes at this price with no settlement fee.

perps.settlement_sequence.description: Engine sequence of the accepted instrument settlement event.

perps.settlement_timestamp.description: Settlement cutoff as integer Unix milliseconds. The trailing 30-minute index average ends at this time.

perps.since_seq.description: Backfill anchor for gap recovery. Pass the sequence number (sq) of the last notifications data frame you processed before the gap, never the sq of a resync frame. perps.size.description: Signed position size in no. of contracts (positive = long, negative = short)

perps.slip_bps.description: Per-order market-trigger slippage cap in basis points. 0 = use the per-instrument default. Clamped to the instrument cap.

perps.sort.description: Time sort direction. `desc` (default) returns newest fills first; `asc` returns oldest first.

perps.st.description: Order status, such as `open` for a resting order. See [Handle Terminal Order Outcomes](/perps/trading#handle-terminal-order-outcomes) for the statuses that end an order.

perps.start_date.description: Inclusive UTC start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

perps.sz.description: Signed position size in no. of contracts (positive = long, negative = short)

perps.taker.description: Whether this side was the taker

perps.taker_fee_rate.description: Exchange taker fee rate as a decimal fraction, excluding any per-order builder fee

perps.taker_volume_7d.description: Rolling 7-day perpetual taker volume in USD

perps.token.description: Token contract address in hex format

perps.total_maintenance_margin.description: Total maintenance margin across all positions

perps.total_position_value.description: Total notional position value in USD

perps.unread.description: Count of the authenticated owner's unread notifications within the retention window.

perps.version.description: Exchange version used in the EIP-712 domain.

perps.volume_7d.description: Rolling 7-day perpetual trading volume in USD

perps.withdrawal_fee.description: Withdrawal transaction fee in decimalized asset units

party.description: The side the verdict is about, when it is about one.

rfq.MarketSource.description: `gamma` for a Polymarket market id, `bespoke` for a bespoke market, `combo` for a market defined by its `legs`.

rfq.Order.description: A CTF Exchange v2 order, in the field order and encoding it is signed in.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds the order was built at.

builder.description: bytes32 hex. The partner's builder code, set by the service.

source.description: `unavailable` when no midpoint could be read; `mark`, `lower` and `upper` are then omitted.

signatureType.description: The order signature type. `3` (deposit wallet) is the type partner trades use.

fees.description: The fee each side will be charged, keyed like `orders`.

expiresAt.description: After this, a submission of these orders is refused as stale.

typedData.description: The nested ERC-7739 payload to pass to `eth_signTypedData_v4`.

digest.description: The hash the raw ECDSA signature verifies against.

signatureSuffix.description: Appended to the raw signature to form the submitted one (`rawSignature || signatureSuffix`).

tolerance.description: The fraction of each mark the band spans.

band.description: The band the price was judged against, for the token the request priced.

rfq.RejectionReason.description: The machine-readable reason a check failed or a request was rejected. New values may be added. See the guardrail and validation guides for each one.

rfq.Role.description: Which fee rate a side pays. Set it on both sides or on neither; omitted, the `yes` side of a split or merge and the `buyer` of a trade are the taker.

timestamp.description: The same instant in Unix seconds, ready to use as `RFQ-Timestamp`.

rfq.SignedOrder.description: An `Order` exactly as prepared, with its signature.

fees.description: The fee each side is charged, keyed like the trade's parties.

transactionHash.description: Set once the trade has executed, so only on a replay.

rfq.TradeState.description: `PENDING` until the trade lands on-chain (`FILLED`) or is refused or fails (`REJECTED`).

failureReason.description: Why a `REJECTED` trade failed. `execution_failed` is a failure after submission to the exchange.

valid.description: Whether a submission of these terms would be accepted now.

guardrails.description: One entry per guardrail, in the order they run. The first failure is the one a submission returns.
